name: Reminders that rebook
short: Yearly services, MOTs and regular cuts remind the customer and book themselves.
long: Repeat work comes round on its own: the boiler service, the MOT, the six-weekly cut. The customer gets a reminder before it is due and books from the link; the booking drops into the diary without a phone call.
proves: Last year’s customers come back before they search.
features: Everything due, sent and booked, in one list
Reminders sent two, three or four weeks ahead
Customers book from the reminder, straight into the diary
The repeat work booked this year, counted
story: Repeat work is the cheapest work there is, and most firms leave it to a leaflet. This sends the reminder for them.
